<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== DIALOGUE MERGE 409 - THE TABLE LOADED BY ITS TRUE OBJECT NAME, THEN THE MERGE RUNS (Job 408 stands as the record: the struct redirect patch landed and verified - two ASCII occurrences of /Script/OMNI patched to /Script/VEIL, byte diff exactly 8, size identical at 5814, the post census standing at OMNI 0 and VEIL 2 - and the RowStruct and VerifyImport refusals are gone with it. The load then missed at a new gate named in the commandlet log: Failed to find object Object /Game/Data/DT_Dialogue_OMNI, because the object inside the package keeps its original name DT_Dialogue, as the job 407 refusal itself printed when it named the table /Game/Data/DT_Dialogue_OMNI.DT_Dialogue. The default lookup by package name walks past the object; the full object path names it exactly. THIS JOB, merged base at D:\VEIL-OMNI: one, verify the scratch stands patched - print its size and the ASCII counts of /Script/OMNI and /Script/VEIL, expecting 0 and 2, and if the counts differ print SCRATCH STATE UNEXPECTED with the counts and stop without writing. Two, load the OMNI table by its full object path /Game/Data/DT_Dialogue_OMNI.DT_Dialogue in a pythonscript commandlet, printing which load road landed it, then its row count and every row name; if it still loads None, print the refusal lines from the commandlet log and stop with the base table untouched. Three, load the base table the same way and print its census. Four, merge as 407 and 408 shaped it - export both tables through export_to_json_string, base rows first and OMNI rows appended with any name collision printed, fill_from_json_string into the base table, save the base table asset. Five, verify from a fresh commandlet load: print the base table row count and every row name in order, the verdict MERGE COMPLETE rows=37 when V01-V19 and O01-O18 all stand, otherwise MERGE INCOMPLETE with the actual count and the missing names. Six, remove the scratch copy only after the verdict prints, printing SCRATCH REMOVED; the archive copy and the dt408 backup remain the sources of record.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 10) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 NAMED HOLD: EDITOR STILL STANDING AFTER THE 100 SECOND IN-JOB WAIT - no commandlet launched into the contention'; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'PHI DT409 EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: no editor standing - proceeding on the clear road'
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$scratch = "$base\Content\Data\DT_Dialogue_OMNI.uasset"
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: SCRATCH STATE VERIFY ---'
if (-not (Test-Path $scratch)) { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 SCRATCH ABSENT - the patched scratch copy does not stand in the base'; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
$py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $py) { $py = (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
if (-not $py) { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 PYTHON NOT FOUND'; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "PHI DT409 PYTHON: $py"
$pyC = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyC = $pyC.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt409_check_out.txt'")
$pyC = $pyC.Replace('SCRATCHPATH', "'$scratch'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_check.py" -Value $pyC -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_check_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $py "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_check.py" *> "$base\Saved\dt409_check.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_check_out.txt") { $cout = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_check_out.txt"; $cout | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT409 CHECK OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt409_check.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
$cjoined = $cout -join "`n"
if ($cjoined -match 'SCRATCH STATE UNEXPECTED') { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 STOPPED AT THE CHECK - the scratch bytes do not stand in the patched state'; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
if ($cjoined -notmatch 'SCRATCH STATE OK') { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 CHECK DID NOT CONFIRM THE PATCHED STATE - stop before the merge'; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: LOAD AND MERGE COMMANDLET ---'
$pyM = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyM = $pyM.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt409_merge_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_merge.py" -Value $pyM -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_merge_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt409_merge.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt409_merge.log"
$mout = $null
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_merge_out.txt") { $mout = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_merge_out.txt"; $mout | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT409 MERGE OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt409_merge.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
$mjoined = $mout -join "`n"
if (($mjoined -match 'OMNI LOAD NONE') -or ($mjoined -match 'BASE LOAD NONE')) {
  Write-Output 'MERGE HELD AT THE LOAD'
  Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt409_merge.log" -Pattern 'Error|Failed|DT_Dialogue|RowStruct' | Select-Object -Last 10 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
  Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return
}
if ($mjoined -notmatch 'MERGE WRITTEN') { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 MERGE DID NOT WRITE - stop before verify'; Write-Output 'JOB 409 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: VERIFY COMMANDLET - FRESH LOAD ---'
$pyV = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$pyV = $pyV.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$base\Saved\phi_dt409_verify_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_verify.py" -Value $pyV -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_verify_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_dt409_verify.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\dt409_verify.log"
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_verify_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_dt409_verify_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO DT409 VERIFY OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\dt409_verify.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 4: SCRATCH REMOVAL ---'
Remove-Item $scratch -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if (Test-Path $scratch) { Write-Output 'PHI DT409 SCRATCH STILL STANDING AFTER REMOVAL ATTEMPT' } else { Write-Output 'SCRATCH REMOVED' }
Write-Output 'JOB 409 DONE'
```
